Mod.Name: Timer Plus
Mod.Author: wizz6rd
Mod.Description:
One block that is up to thirty-two of Besiege's timer blocks. Each row of its table is a timer with the same settings the game's own has -- activation key or variable, hold to run, allow stop, loop, wait, emulation duration and the key or variable it presses -- and the rows can be sorted by any column. A button at the bottom converts the table into that many real timer blocks, laid out on one horizontal plane and handed over as a selection.
Block model by Poly by Google, from Poly Pizza, under CC-BY 3.0. The settings panel needs UI Factory (Workshop item 2913469777); without it the block falls back to Besiege's own block mapper.
